meta.title: Envy Nail Spa · Nail salon & spa in Wendell, NC
meta.description: Clean, professional, high-quality nail care in Wendell, NC: acrylic, dip powder, Gel-X, manicures, signature pedicures and waxing. Appointments and walk-ins welcome.

hero.title: Clean. Professional.
hero.text: Envy Nail Spa is known for clean, professional, high-quality services. Our highly trained staff use only branded, high-grade products in a relaxing atmosphere, so you can simply sit back and enjoy.
hero.photoAlt: Almond nails in a soft blue-grey gel with hand-painted blue flowers
hero.photoAlt2: Short grey gel manicure with gold foil accents

menu.title: Our price list
menu.intro: Prices marked + start from the amount shown and depend on length, design and condition. Please confirm prices with your nail tech before your service.

notes.enhancement: Regular polish and gel polish are priced the same for artificial nails.
notes.kids: For children under 9. Regular polish can smudge or mix during kids' activities, so it has no warranty: please check your child's nails before leaving to make sure the color looks right. Thanks for understanding!

items.takeOffGelDip: Take off gel polish / dip only

styles.title: Little details, big difference
styles.intro: Add a finish to any manicure, pedicure or full set. Bring a photo of the look you love and our techs will recreate it.

gift.title: A special gift for you
gift.text: Treat someone to a manicure, a signature pedicure or a full afternoon of pampering. Gift certificates are available in any amount at the front desk.
points: Perfect for birthdays, holidays and thank-yous
Ask at the front desk or call us
gift.fineprint: Gift certificates have no cash value and cannot be replaced if lost or stolen.

policy.title: For the mutual interests of our clients and the salon
items: Please let us know about any health concerns, including diabetes, before your service.
Prices are on our menu. Please confirm them with your nail tech before receiving services.
Please give us advance notice if you need to cancel your appointment.
Ask for the service you would like. If you need clarification, please talk to the salon manager.
We do not provide refunds on services, but we will resolve any issue with the service itself.
If you are unsatisfied with our service, please inform the salon manager.
We are not responsible for lost or stolen personal items or gift cards, or for damage to belongings.
We reserve the right to refuse or stop service for anyone who is rude.
policy.thanks: We want to thank you for your continued patronage! It is our pleasure to serve you.

visit.title: We'd love to see you
visit.text: Appointments and walk-ins are welcome. Call ahead to reserve your favorite time.
visit.imageAlt: Spa candle, essential oil, bath salts and rolled towels
